patches.name: sample-sparse-vector-axes

idempotence: Return unchanged if all new blocks present and no old blocks; otherwise demand exact upstream SHA and each old block exactly once.
limitations: Sparse cubic/auto axes are linearly approximated between retained source knots.
No native evaluator parity or skin quality claim.
Only unique transformData-bearing same-ID model is eligible; ambiguity fails closed.

The unchanged r180 large-angle quaternion branch can lose a single 0-to-360-degree Euler span without intermediate union keys; the regression is an explicit expected failure, not universal turn support.
Missing rotation-axis support is unchanged; the compatibility patch covers all-three-axis rotation tracks and sparse or missing translation/scale axes.
